notes.title: Titan Force Patch Notes – Update v.04b
notes.notes:
[p]We've rolled out some changes to improve gameplay, movement, and overall accessibility for all testers. Here's what’s new:

Weapons & Combat[/p][list][*][p][b]Reduced .308 damage[/b] for better weapon balancing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shotgun tweaked[/b]: Damage increased, but effective range slightly reduced.[/p][/*][/list][p]Mech Improvements[/p][list][*][p][b]Mech preview now available[/b] — UI may still be a bit unresponsive, but core functionality works.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stamina removed[/b] from player characters for freer movement. [i](Mech stamina is still in play.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Mech now starts with jetpack[/b] equipped for immediate vertical mobility.[/p][/*][/list][p]Enemies & World[/p][list][*][p][b]Flying mobs added[/b] from the very start to spice up early encounters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Building costs reduced[/b] — go wild and experiment more freely![/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed mining bug[/b] that prevented players from breaking rocks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed game ending when host dies[/b] — matches now continue without interruption.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed mutant spawner glitch[/b] where mutants were getting stuck.
[/p][p]
Thank you again for all your support and feedback during testing. Your insights are shaping Titan Force into something awesome.[/p][p]Let us know what you think and keep the bug reports coming![/p][/*][/list]
